body:
Update packages/prosecute/lib/schema.mjs and packages/prosecute/lib/run.mjs so passes with zero verified and zero needs-human findings count as dry (advancing consecutiveDry) and low-severity findings can be recorded with verified_status deferred when accompanied by follow_up and reason.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A pass whose only findings are killed or deferred is classified as dry: true, updates openFindings/deferredFindings, and advances consecutiveDry. Verify: node --test packages/prosecute/test/prosecute-consecutive-dry.test.mjs packages/prosecute/test/prosecute-findings-lifecycle.test.mjs
2. verified_status deferred is accepted only for severity low with non-empty follow_up and reason, and p5-complete records deferredIds. Verify: node --test packages/prosecute/test/prosecute-schema-validation.test.mjs packages/prosecute/test/prosecute-findings-lifecycle.test.mjs
title: prosecute: count killed-only passes as dry and support deferred low findings (#1212, #1182)
